correctness.rationale: For GP(n,2), cubic graph with vertices a_i,b_i, edges outer a_i a_(i+1), spokes a_i b_i, inner b_i b_(i+2), one sensor cannot propagate for n≥9. The full successful pair list is n outer pairs a_i,a_(i+3), n inner b_i,b_(i+1), and 4n mixed pairs a_i,b_(i±3,±4), total 6n. For n≥21, length≤3 walks give an exhaustive local type table; four observed consecutive columns propagate, and every omitted type stalls. Smaller n=9..20 exhausted exactly with independent forcing rules; fresh independent enumeration also verified 9..24,29,37,61. Successful-pair graph on 2n sensor sites has 6-regular degree and 6n edges; its line graph is connected, 10-regular, 30n edges. For n≥13 exactly n of 7n distance-three pairs fail: b_i,b_(i+6). n=13 b0,b6 distance 3 and stalls with 10/26 observed. A finite sample is not the all-n proof; all-n step uses stable combinatorial local argument.
residual_risks: Finite experiments and exact checks do not alone establish infinite/uniform quantifiers; proof reconstructed from original RESULT.md.
